title: Compliance evidence playbook: customizable scheduled deliveries and multi-format exports
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Deliver a configurable "playbook" for tenant-scoped compliance evidence that supports scheduled deliveries, PDF and CSV packaging, and optional dashboard snapshots. Customers should be able to define per-tenant delivery cadence, choose formats (signed PDF, encrypted CSV, or archive bundle), apply residency filters, and attach contextual metadata (policy version, retention window, and KMS key ID). The playbook will be exposed in Console and via the Management API, tying into existing audit log and evidence collection pipelines.
acceptance_criteria: Console UI: tenant-level 'Evidence Playbook' panel where admins can create/update schedules with frequency (daily/weekly/monthly/custom), timezone, and destination (S3/FTP/email).
Export formats: generated packages must support signed PDF (with audit header), CSV ledger with schema v2, and a zipped bundle containing both plus JSON metadata.
Residency & retention: playbook respects tenant residency filters and retention settings; exported packages only contain records within specified residency scope and retention window.
Scheduling: scheduled jobs appear in a 'Scheduled Deliveries' table with last-run, next-run, status, and retry policy. Failures produce an incident and retry according to policy.
API parity: Management API endpoints to create/update/delete playbooks and trigger one-off runs; responses include job IDs and links to generated artifacts.
Security: all exports are encrypted at rest and in transit; when tenant KMS is configured, the package is encrypted with customer key and KMS key ID is included in metadata.
Audit & evidence: each exported file includes an evidence index with checksum and signer identity; console shows proof-of-delivery entries for 90 days.
success_metrics: Enable 75% of enterprise trial tenants with compliance needs to configure a playbook during onboarding by EOW release+4 weeks.
Reduce manual export requests (support tickets) by 60% for tenants with scheduled deliveries within 12 weeks.
Zero unencrypted exported artifacts in production by release rollout (encryption enforcement gated in PRD).
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (beta): API + minimal Console form, S3/email destinations, daily/weekly schedules, limited to EU/US residency scopes; internal opt-in tenants for testing.
Phase 2: add CSV schema v2, signed PDFs, FTP destination, per-tenant KMS encryption, dashboard snapshot attachments; gated customer pilot signups.
Phase 3: GA: full UI polish, retries/alerting, multi-region routing, compliance docs and runbook, enable for all enterprise tenants.
notes: Design: need a compact evidence file format to minimize tokenization; discuss with Design for PDF header layout and signer stamp.
Engineering: reuse audit index pipeline and S3 delivery connector; work with ENG on efficient region-aware query slices to avoid cross-region egress during export.
Legal/Security: export metadata must include policy version and notarization hash for downstream compliance teams. Plan security review during Phase 1 completion.
